title: Bharat AQI Lakehouse
description: Enterprise-grade Medallion Lakehouse monitoring real-time air quality & meteorology across 20 major Indian municipal hubs. Orchestrates hourly batch ETL via Apache Airflow 2.10, PySpark silver normalization, dbt Core dimensional modeling, Great Expectations quality contracts, MinIO S3 object storage, and a Streamlit executive intelligence dashboard.

architecture.summary: Decoupled Medallion Lakehouse architecture: hourly REST extraction -> MinIO Bronze JSON audit landing -> PySpark distributed normalization -> Great Expectations validation -> Idempotent PostgreSQL upsert -> dbt Core dimensional analytics.

steps.name: Multi-City Telemetry Ingestion
steps.role: Orchestrates concurrent hourly extraction of 8 atmospheric pollutants and 5 surface meteorological variables across 20 Indian cities using Airflow Dynamic Task Mapping.

steps.name: Bronze Layer Immutable Landing
steps.role: Stores raw immutable JSON payloads in partitioned paths (/bronze/aqi/year=YYYY/month=MM/day=DD/hour=HH/city=CITY), ensuring zero audit trail loss.

steps.name: PySpark Silver Distributed Normalization
steps.role: Flattens nested JSON arrays, normalizes dual timestamps (UTC and IST UTC+05:30), casts sensor float types, and writes Snappy-compressed Parquet.

steps.name: In-Pipeline Quality Gatekeeping
steps.role: Executes automated validation suite: checks non-null primary keys, valid coordinate bounds, pollutant range thresholds (0-1000 ug/m3), halting pipeline on anomalies.

steps.name: Idempotent Warehouse Merge
steps.role: Executes atomic merge upsert with ON CONFLICT (city_name, timestamp_utc) DO UPDATE, guaranteeing zero duplicate records during retries or backfills.

steps.name: dbt Star Schema & Executive Intelligence
steps.role: Transforms silver data into conformed star schema (dim_city, fct_air_quality_hourly, city_daily_aqi) serving interactive Streamlit analytics & Telegram alerts.
steps.output: Gold Star Schema & Live Visual Insights

title: Inventra — Agentic Stockout Resolution
description: Production agentic stockout-resolution system preventing warehouse shortages through evidence-based, human-in-the-loop replenishment. Architected with LangGraph, SQLite checkpointing, Pydantic validation, and 3 specialized LLM agents (Investigator, Sizer, Policy Reviewer) bounded by deterministic Python rules.

architecture.summary: Human-in-the-loop Agentic workflow: LangGraph multi-agent graph with SQLite checkpoint state, deterministic Python bounds, policy compliance verification, and human approval interrupts.

steps.name: Warehouse Telemetry Ingestion
steps.role: Gathers operational stock levels, safety thresholds, reorder points, and supplier lead times for candidate warehouse SKUs.

steps.name: Investigator Agent & Evidence Gathering
steps.role: Analyzes daily consumption variance, pending purchase orders, and stockout risk, corroborated by pure Python verification logic.

steps.name: Replenishment Sizer Agent
steps.tool: Order Sizer Agent & Economic Order Quantity
steps.role: Determines optimal replenishment quantity, MOQ compliance, batch increments, unit pricing, and estimated delivery dates.

steps.name: Policy & Compliance Verification
steps.tool: Policy Reviewer Agent & Hard Gatekeeper Rules
steps.role: Evaluates proposal against spend authorization matrices, single-supplier limits, and warehouse storage capacity constraints.

steps.name: Human-in-the-Loop Interrupt
steps.role: Pauses stateful graph execution, dispatches approval notification to authorized procurement manager, and awaits human decision.

steps.name: Revalidation & Purchase Order Creation
steps.role: Revalidates live inventory state to prevent race conditions, and deterministically generates finalized Purchase Order record.

title: Finance Analyzer
description: Web-based finance management system using Django and Jinja Templates. Processed bank statement CSVs using Pandas for automated transaction categorization, overspending detection, and subscription tracking with actionable financial reports.

architecture.summary: Automated ETL financial analysis pipeline: CSV ingestion to Pandas classification, PostgreSQL storage, and real-time budgeting insight reports.

steps.name: Bank Statement Ingestion
steps.role: Receives CSV statements, validates required columns (Date, Description, Amount), and streams into memory.

steps.name: Data Cleaning & Parsing
steps.role: Executes pd.read_csv, normalizes dates with pd.to_datetime, cleans whitespace, and formats Decimals.

steps.name: Transaction Classification
steps.role: Differentiates positive amounts as Income and negative amounts as Expenses with automatic category assignment.

steps.name: Recurring Subscriptions Engine
steps.role: Identifies recurring merchants, computes billing intervals, and flags renewal alerts.

steps.name: Relational Persistence
steps.role: Stores indexed user transactions, categories, and monthly summaries with ACID relational integrity.

steps.name: Financial Analytics Dashboard
steps.role: Computes savings rate (savings / total_income * 100), aggregate spend by category, and generates reports.

title: Smart College Resource Sharing Platform
description: Full-stack academic resource platform enabling students to upload, search, and review course materials with role-based access control. Features Django REST Framework APIs, JWT authentication, Cloudinary storage, and gamified engagement leaderboards.

architecture.summary: Role-based academic collaboration platform: Secure JWT gateway, paginated REST APIs, Cloudinary CDN distribution, and gamified ranking logic.

steps.name: Dual-Role Authentication
steps.role: Enforces Role-Based Access Control for Students, Faculty, and Admins with JWT tokens and OTP password reset.

steps.name: Academic Resource Engine
steps.role: Manages course notes, question papers (PYQs), and presentations filtered by Branch (CSE, IT, ECE, MECH, CIVIL) and Semester.

steps.name: Cloud Media Distribution
steps.role: Direct PDF & document upload pipeline with automatic compression and global edge CDN caching.

steps.name: Relational Data Layer
steps.role: Maintains ACID relational schema for user uploads, course bookmarks, ratings, and peer reviews.

steps.name: Engagement & Community
steps.role: Peer Lounge chat communication, contributor karma score computation, student leaderboards, and AI quiz generation.

title: Real-Time Stock Market Data Pipeline
description: End-to-end distributed data engineering pipeline ingesting real-time stock market data with Apache Kafka. MinIO object storage for data lake layers, automated ingestion into Snowflake using Airflow DAGs, and dbt analytics transformation containerized with Docker.

architecture.summary: Distributed streaming data lakehouse: High-throughput Kafka ingestion, MinIO Bronze lake, Airflow orchestration, and dbt analytics in Snowflake.

steps.name: Finnhub Market Stream
steps.role: Polls real-time financial market quotes for AAPL, MSFT, TSLA, GOOGL, and AMZN via Finnhub REST API.

steps.name: Message Streaming Queue
steps.role: KafkaProducer serializes quotes into JSON and streams them to the partitioned stock_topic queue.

steps.name: Bronze Lake Object Store
steps.role: Consumer daemon reads messages from stock_topic and writes immutable raw JSON batches to MinIO object storage.

steps.name: Pipeline Orchestration
steps.role: DAG minio_to_snowflake downloads objects from MinIO and stages them for Snowflake loading with auto-retries.

steps.name: Cloud Data Warehousing
steps.role: Loads structured stock market data into landing stage tables using snowflake.connector in scalable virtual warehouses.

steps.name: Analytics & Visualization
steps.role: dbt transforms raw data into Silver/Gold models (moving averages, volatility), visualized in real-time via dashboard/app.py.

title: Large-Scale Taxi Data Pipeline
description: Scalable NYC Yellow Taxi data pipeline ingesting streams via Kafka into MinIO Bronze/Silver storage tiers. High-performance data transformation with Polars, orchestrated via Apache Airflow, analytics in Snowflake, and interactive Streamlit visualization dashboard.

architecture.summary: Lakehouse ETL & Visualization: Kafka event streaming, MinIO tiered storage, Polars vectorized transformations, Snowflake data warehouse, and Streamlit UI.

steps.name: Taxi Stream Ingestion
steps.role: Streams millions of NYC Yellow Taxi trip records through high-throughput Kafka topics with backpressure handling.

steps.name: Bronze Lake Storage
steps.role: Stores raw streaming taxi event logs in MinIO taxi-bronze bucket partitioned by year and month.

steps.name: Vectorized ETL Processing
steps.role: bronze_to_silver.py runs in-memory Polars transformations: trip duration, tip percentage, and rate code mapping.

steps.name: Silver Tier Storage
steps.role: Persists transformed taxi data as Snappy-compressed columnar Parquet files into taxi-silver bucket.

steps.name: Cloud Warehouse Loading
steps.role: Airflow DAG taxi_bronze_to_silver orchestrates pipeline execution and triggers load_silver.py into Snowflake.

steps.name: Live Analytics Dashboard
steps.role: Connects live to Snowflake, rendering geospatial hotspot heatmaps, trip duration trends, and fare distributions.

title: React Recipe Application
description: Interactive recipe discovery single-page web app engineered with React.js and the Mealdb REST API. Features real-time dish searching, cuisine filtering, responsive card grid layouts, and ingredient breakdowns.

architecture.summary: Component-driven single page application: React state machine, asynchronous REST integration, responsive CSS grid, and modal detail rendering.

steps.name: User Query & Filter Input
steps.role: Captures user search ingredient inputs and cuisine area filter clicks in reactive state.

steps.name: Asynchronous REST Queries
steps.role: Fetches recipes from TheMealDB endpoints filter.php?a={area} and search.php?s={ingredient}.

steps.name: State Management & Hydration
steps.role: Hydrates mealdata state inside useEffect([area]) and triggers re-renders on filter changes.

steps.name: Responsive Card Grid
steps.role: Maps over mealdata array to render recipe cards with strMealThumb images and responsive flex/grid layouts.

title: Dynamic Blog & Content Platform
description: Full-featured blogging and microblog platform built with Django and Jinja templates. Includes full CRUD post publishing, custom form handling, admin panel management, and media optimization for fast image delivery.

architecture.summary: Server-Side Rendered (SSR) Publishing Architecture: Django MVC engine, Cloudinary media CDN, database CRUD, and Jinja template compilation.

steps.name: Authentication & Permissions
steps.role: UserRegistrationForm handles signups, while @login_required decorator protects publishing endpoints.

steps.name: Post Authoring & Media Upload
steps.role: tweetForm validates post text (max 250 chars) and handles image uploads via ImageField upload_to='photo/'.

steps.name: Database Persistence (CRUD)
steps.role: Persists Tweet model instances with ForeignKey to User, created_at, and updated_at timestamps.

steps.name: Server-Side Template Compilation
steps.role: Tweet_List compiles tweet_list.html on the server using distinct querysets for fast initial page load.
